title: Huntington Insurance Named a 2026 Best Place to Work in Insurance by Business Insurance Magazine
summary: National recognition reflects Huntington Insurance's people-first culture COLUMBUS, Ohio, Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Huntington Insurance Inc.…...
body_markdown:
*National recognition reflects Huntington Insurance's people-first culture*


COLUMBUS, Ohio


, Sept. 1, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Huntington Insurance Inc. has been named one of *Business Insurance* magazine's 2026 Best Places to Work in Insurance. The award recognizes employers that excel in creating workplaces where employees are engaged, supported and empowered to succeed. The honor reflects Huntington Insurance's commitment to fostering a collaborative culture where colleagues can build rewarding careers while delivering exceptional service to customers.


A licensed agency and wholly-owned subsidiary of Huntington Bancshares Incorporated, Huntington Insurance provides comprehensive commercial, employee benefits, title, personal and life insurance solutions to businesses and individuals.


"Our success begins with our people," said Angie Klett, president of Huntington Insurance. "Their expertise, dedication and commitment to one another helps us deliver exceptional service and trusted guidance to our customers. Whether customers work with us for insurance services alone or as part of their broader relationship with Huntington, our focus is helping them protect what matters most and achieve their goals with confidence."


Best Places to Work in Insurance is an annual sponsored content feature presented by the Custom Publishing unit of Business Insurance and Best Companies Group that lists the agents, brokers, insurance companies and other providers with the highest levels of employee engagement and satisfaction.


Huntington Insurance colleagues benefit from competitive health and retirement offerings, professional development opportunities, and meaningful pathways for career growth. Through Business Resource Groups, mentorship and leadership development initiatives, Huntington fosters a culture of belonging where colleagues are supported both personally and professionally. Recognition programs such as At the Heart of Huntington and Colleague Appreciation Week, along with community-focused initiatives like Service Heart Day, reinforce the company's people-first culture and commitment to purpose. Together, these programs help colleagues build rewarding careers while making a positive impact on customers, communities and one another.


The ranking and profiles of the winning companies will be unveiled in the November issue of *Business Insurance* and online at BusinessInsurance.com.


For additional information on Huntington Insurance, visit[Huntington.com/Personal/Insurance](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4764868-1&h=3568982765&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.huntington.com%2FPersonal%2Finsurance&a=Huntington.com%2FPersonal%2FInsurance) or[Huntington.com/Commercial/Insurance.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4764868-1&h=1672536325&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.huntington.com%2FCommercial%2Finsurance&a=Huntington.com%2FCommercial%2FInsurance.)


**About Huntington**


Huntington Bancshares Incorporated is a $284 billion asset regional bank holding company headquartered in Columbus, Ohio. A top 10 U.S. commercial bank, The Huntington National Bank and its affiliates provide consumers, small and middle-market businesses, corporations, municipalities, and other organizations with a comprehensive suite of banking, payments, wealth management, and risk management products and services. Founded in 1866, Huntington operates over 1,400 branches in 21 states, with certain businesses operating nationally. Visit Huntington.com for more information.
